subject: ClearShore: coordination call & initial evidence list
body:
From: Lauren Brooks <lauren.brooks@clearshore.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearshore.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood - kickoff call to cover SOC 2 + CAIQ evidence needs

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. ClearShore is starting a vendor review for SOC 2 and CAIQ coverage; we want to schedule a short call (30 minutes) to align scope and get an initial list of artifacts you can share.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm SOC 2 coverage (in-scope services / vesting date)
- Establish primary evidence owners for controls (incidents, access, change mgmt)
- Example network/infrastructure diagrams and logging retention details
- Any pre-signed NDA or conduit for large artifacts (SIEM exports, full config)

Are you available next week for a 30-min sync? Timezone PST works best for us.

Thanks,
Lauren Brooks
Senior Security Manager | ClearShore
lauren.brooks@clearshore.com
(415) 555-0123

-----
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Brooks <lauren.brooks@clearshore.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, security@clearshore.com
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood - kickoff call to cover SOC 2 + CAIQ evidence needs

Hi Lauren — great to meet you. Thanks for outlining the requests. We can definitely walk through scope and provide an initial artifact pack.

Available slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-21 10:00–10:30am
- Tue 2026-12-21 2:00–2:30pm
- Wed 2026-12-22 9:30–10:00am

On the initial evidence we can attach a short packet now so your team has context:
- Redwood SOC 2 summary (scope & date) — redwood-soc2-scope-overview.pdf (attached)
- High-level infra diagram — redwood-network-diagram.png (attached)
- Controls matrix (CAIQ crosswalk) — we'll provide a first draft after the call

For items that typically require an internal owner:
- SIEM/alerting exports (we can provide sanitized samples) — owner: Mina Haddad (cc'd)
- KMS / key rotation doc — owner: Security Ops (we will surface team contact on call)
- Change management evidence (deployment runbooks, PR approvals) — owner: Platform Eng

If any of your reviewers need access to a secure artifact bucket (S3 presigned links) or a CNH for secure upload, let us know and we can provision.

I'll hold the Tue 2pm slot tentatively; Mina will help assemble the sample logs and the CAIQ mapping after we confirm.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0789

Attachments: redwood-soc2-scope-overview.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-network-diagram.png (image/png)

-----
From: Lauren Brooks <lauren.brooks@clearshore.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearshore.com
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - kickoff call to cover SOC 2 + CAIQ evidence needs

Thanks Markus — Tue 2:00pm PST works for us, confirmed.

Two quick clarifications ahead of the call so we can prep:
1) For SIEM samples, can you provide a 7-day window of alerts and a mapped schema (field names)? We only need sample lines, not raw PII.
2) For key management: does Redwood use a customer-specific KMS (bring-your-own-key) option or only internal-managed keys? If BYOK is supported, an overview of the integration flow is helpful.

Also, we may request a redacted incident report for one historical incident as a review artifact — would that be OK?

Lauren

On Tue, Dec 21, 2026 at 14:05 Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Lauren — great, see you at 2pm PST.
>
> Quick answers ahead of the call:
> 1) SIEM: we can provide 7-days of alert samples (JSON newline format) with field mapping; Mina will prepare a sanitized export.
> 2) KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments via KMS/HSM integrations; for Hosted accounts we use Redwood-managed keys by default. We'll include a short BYOK flow diagram.
>
> Regarding the redacted incident report: yes, we can share one historical postmortem with PII removed — security review redaction only.
>
> Action owners pre-call:
> - Mina Haddad: prepare SIEM sample + mapping; provide estimated retention window for logs (default 90 days, optional longer retention for Dedicated).
> - Markus: share SOC 2 scope doc + infra diagram (attached) and meeting invite.
>
> See you on the call,
> Markus

-----
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Brooks <lauren.brooks@clearshore.com>, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - kickoff call to cover SOC 2 + CAIQ evidence needs

Hi Lauren and Markus — I finished the SIEM sample export and the field mapping CSV. Summary: the sample is a 7-day window (2026-12-01 to 2026-12-07), sanitized of user identifiers and IPs; retention defaults are 90 days for ingestion events and 365 days for audit logs in Dedicated.

Included artifacts (we can upload to your secure bucket or share presigned links on the call):
- siem-sample-7d.jsonl (7k lines sample compressed)
- siem-field-mapping.csv
- kms-byok-flow.svg
- redacted-postmortem-2025-11-18.pdf

Notes / quick answers:
- BYOK: supported for Private deployments; Hosted customers can request CMK export for limited scenarios via SOC approval.
- Audit log retention: Dedicated tenants have configurable retention via Console; we can propose retention settings in the follow-up.
- Evidence owners: I will be primary contact for SIEM/logging artifacts; I'll loop in Security Ops for KMS and postmortem sign-off.

Next steps (post-call):
- Upload artifacts to ClearShore secure bucket (we'll request the upload endpoint)
- Deliver initial CAIQ mapping draft within 3 business days

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments (ready to share): siem-sample-7d.jsonl, siem-field-mapping.csv, kms-byok-flow.svg, redacted-postmortem-2025-11-18.pdf

-----
[Thread metadata]
- Confirmed meeting: 2026-12-21T14:00:00-08:00 (30 min)
- Action items: Assemble artifact upload, provide CAIQ mapping draft, schedule follow-up for deeper log access if needed
- Secure artifacts to be delivered via presigned S3 links or Redacted PDF for incident reports
